description: Ramp connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's Ramp card transactions as ramp:transaction items in the local index — the merchant name, the amount + currency, the card holder's display name and department, the transaction state, the spend category, the transaction time, and a truncated memo. Useful for spend questions ("what did I spend at AWS last month?", "find my transactions in the Engineering department") without leaving Nimbus. OAuth2 client-credentials auth: the connector exchanges its client id + client secret for a bearer token at POST /developer/v1/token (HTTP Basic auth, transactions:read scope) and caches the token for the process, then calls the data endpoints with Authorization: Bearer. Two required secret credentials (a client id + a client secret) selecting the Ramp developer application. The SaaS host (api.ramp.com) is fixed. The /developer/v1/transactions endpoint paginates by a page.next cursor (a full URL to the next page, or null at the end); the connector walks a single forward pass per cycle, page-capped. No full card numbers or PANs are surfaced — Ramp's API does not return them and only the safe transaction fields are mapped.
author: Nimbus
